name: Piracetam

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: The original racetam, a cyclic derivative of GABA, approved in several European countries for myoclonus and cognitive indications. The FDA has stated it does not meet the statutory definition of a dietary ingredient, so it is neither an approved drug nor a lawful supplement in the United States. Approved in some European jurisdictions. FDA has stated it is not a lawful dietary ingredient in the United States.

systems.note: Taken for cognitive effect; the intended effect and the basis of non-US approvals.
Renally cleared essentially unchanged; accumulates in renal impairment.

monitors.why: Cleared renally unchanged; accumulation is the specific concern.
